```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(ggrepel)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(GGally)
```


# Preparation

```{r}
bias_raw <- readr::read_csv(here("Dataset", "bias_WS_Ref_TotalVocab_2026Jul15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
feat_raw <- readr::read_csv(here("Dataset", "LinguisticFeatures.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

bias <- bias_raw %>% mutate(
  language = str_squish(language),
  form     = str_squish(form),
  lexical_class = str_squish(lexical_class),
  measure  = str_squish(measure))
feat <- feat_raw %>% mutate(language = str_squish(language))

bias_ws <- bias %>% filter(form == "WS") %>%
  inner_join(feat, by = "language") %>% 
  subset(lexical_class != "Function Words")

# Check
bias_ws %>% count(lexical_class, measure) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

bias_ws %>% count(language, lexical_class) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```



# Linguistic features and frequency (only those that showed significant effects)

```{r}
df_freq_z <- read.csv(here("Results", "df_freq_z.csv"), header=TRUE)
df_freq_z <- df_freq_z %>% select(language, starts_with("freq_mean"))

bias_ws <- bias_ws %>% select(-order, -lexical_class, -mean, -ci_lower, -ci_upper) %>% inner_join(df_freq_z) %>% 
  distinct()

df_ling_freq <- bias_ws %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("freq_mean"), names_sep = "__", 
               names_to = c("tmp", "Category"), values_to = "mean_freq") %>% 
  select(-tmp) %>% 
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels =c("Nouns", "Verbs", "Adjectives")))


#== Case position

df_ling_freq %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = posCaseAffix, y = mean_freq, fill = posCaseAffix)) +
  # geom_violin(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_boxplot(fill="white", alpha=0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  guides(fill = "none")

df_ling_freq %>% subset(posCaseAffix %in% c("Absent", "CaseSuffixes")) %>% 
  group_by(Category, posCaseAffix) %>% 
  summarise(N.lang = n(), mean_mean_freq = mean(mean_freq), sd_mean_freq = sd(mean_freq))

fit <- lmer(mean_freq ~ Category * posCaseAffix + (1|language), 
     data = df_ling_freq %>% subset(posCaseAffix %in% c("Absent", "CaseSuffixes")))
# summary(fit)
Anova(fit)
emmeans(fit, ~ posCaseAffix | Category) %>% pairs()

fit <- lmer(mean_freq ~ Category * nomPlural + (1|language),
```

# Cultural features and frequency (only those that showed significant effects)

```{r}
df_culture <- read.csv(here("Results", "df_culture.csv"), header=TRUE)

df_cult_freq <- df_culture %>% inner_join(df_freq_z) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("freq_mean"), names_sep = "__", 
               names_to = c("tmp", "Category"), values_to = "mean_freq") %>% 
  select(-tmp) %>% 
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels =c("Nouns", "Verbs", "Adjectives")))


#== Individualism vs. collectivism

df_cult_freq %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = individualism, y = mean_freq, group = Category)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = "none")

fit <- lmer(mean_freq ~ Category * individualism + (1|language), 
     data = df_cult_freq)
# summary(fit)
Anova(fit)
emmeans(fit, ~ individualism | Category, at = list(individualism = c(-1, 1))) %>% pairs()

df_cult_freq %>% group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(individualism, mean_freq, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(individualism, mean_freq)$p.value)
```



# Relations among predictors

```{r}
d_typo <- read.csv(here("Results", "typo_mca.csv"), header=TRUE) %>% select(-matches("_z"))
d_freq <- read.csv(here("Results", "df_freq.csv"), header=TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(language, lexical_category, freq_mean, predicativeAdj) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(predicativeAdj)) %>% select(-predicativeAdj) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = lexical_category, values_from = freq_mean, names_prefix = "freq_")
d_cult <- read.csv(here("Results", "df_culture.csv"), header=TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(language, individualism, flexibility) 

d_all <- bias_raw %>% select(language, lexical_class, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>% 
  inner_join(d_typo) %>% inner_join(d_freq) %>% inner_join(d_cult) %>% 
  rename(bias = mean) %>% 
  mutate(Noun.Dim1 = as.numeric(scale(Noun.Dim1)),
         Noun.Dim2 = as.numeric(scale(Noun.Dim2)),
         Noun.Dim3 = as.numeric(scale(Noun.Dim3)),
         Verb.Dim1 = as.numeric(scale(Verb.Dim1)),
         Verb.Dim2 = as.numeric(scale(Verb.Dim2)),
         Verb.Dim3 = as.numeric(scale(Verb.Dim3)),
         Adj.Dim1  = as.numeric(scale(Adj.Dim1)),
         Adj.Dim2  = as.numeric(scale(Adj.Dim2)),
         Adj.Dim3  = as.numeric(scale(Adj.Dim3)),
         freq_Nouns      = as.numeric(scale(freq_Nouns)),
         freq_Verbs      = as.numeric(scale(freq_Verbs)),
         freq_Adjectives = as.numeric(scale(freq_Adjectives)),
         individualism = as.numeric(scale(individualism)),
         flexibility = as.numeric(scale(flexibility)))

d_all %>% select(Noun.Dim1:flexibility) %>% 
  summarise(across(Noun.Dim1:flexibility, 
                   list(mean = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        sd   = \(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_sep = "__")

d_noun <- d_all %>% filter(lexical_class == "Nouns")
d_verb <- d_all %>% filter(lexical_class == "Verbs")
d_adj  <- d_all %>% filter(lexical_class == "Adjectives")
```


## Noun bias

```{r}
# full model
m_full <- lm(bias ~ 
            Noun.Dim1 + Noun.Dim2 + Noun.Dim3 + 
            freq_Nouns + freq_Verbs + freq_Adjectives +
            individualism + flexibility , data = d_noun)
summary(m_full)
vif(m_full)


# Remove typology block
m_no_typo <- lm(bias ~
              freq_Nouns + freq_Verbs + freq_Adjectives +
              individualism + flexibility, data = d_noun)

# Remove frequency block
m_no_freq <- lm(bias ~
              Noun.Dim1 + Noun.Dim2 + Noun.Dim3 +
              individualism + flexibility, data = d_noun)

# Remove culture block
m_no_cult <- lm(bias ~
              Noun.Dim1 + Noun.Dim2 + Noun.Dim3 +
              freq_Nouns + freq_Verbs + freq_Adjectives, data = d_noun)
```


```{r}
# Blockwise F-tests
anova(m_no_typo, m_full)
anova(m_no_freq, m_full)
anova(m_no_cult, m_full)


# Partial R^2
partial_r2 <- function(reduced, full) {
  sse_reduced <- deviance(reduced)
  sse_full    <- deviance(full)
  (sse_reduced - sse_full) / sse_reduced
}

# Save blockwise results
get_block_result <- function(reduced, full, block) {
  a <- anova(reduced, full)
  
  tibble(block = block,
         df1 = a$Df[2],
         df2 = df.residual(full),
         F = a$F[2],
         p = a$`Pr(>F)`[2],
         partial_R2 = partial_r2(reduced, full))
}

res_noun <- bind_rows(get_block_result(m_no_typo, m_full, "Typology"),
                      get_block_result(m_no_freq, m_full, "Frequency"),
                      get_block_result(m_no_cult, m_full, "Culture")) %>%
  mutate(bias = "Noun")
res_noun

# confirmation of sample consistency
# nobs(m_full)
# nobs(m_no_typo)
# nobs(m_no_freq)
# nobs(m_no_cult)
```


```{r}
# LOOCV prediction (if interested)
d_cv <- model.frame(m_full)

loocv_pred <- function(model, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  pred <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    fit_i <- lm(formula(model), data = data[-i, , drop = FALSE])
    pred[i] <- predict(fit_i, newdata = data[i, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  
  tibble(obs = data$bias,
         pred = pred,
         sq_error = (obs - pred)^2,
         abs_error = abs(obs - pred))
}

cv_metrics <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(x$sq_error)),
    MAE = mean(x$abs_error),
    CV_R2 = 1 - sum(x$sq_error) /
      sum((x$obs - mean(x$obs))^2))
}

cv_full <- loocv_pred(m_full, d_cv)
cv_no_typo <- loocv_pred(m_no_typo, d_cv)
cv_no_freq <- loocv_pred(m_no_freq, d_cv)
cv_no_cult <- loocv_pred(m_no_cult, d_cv)

cv_summary <- bind_rows(cv_metrics(cv_full) %>% mutate(model = "Full"),
                        cv_metrics(cv_no_typo) %>% mutate(model = "No typology"),
                        cv_metrics(cv_no_freq) %>% mutate(model = "No frequency"),
                        cv_metrics(cv_no_cult) %>% mutate(model = "No culture")) %>%
  select(model, everything())
cv_summary

cv_summary %>% filter(model != "Full") %>%
  mutate(block = dplyr::recode(model,
      "No typology" = "Typology",
      "No frequency" = "Frequency",
      "No culture" = "Culture"),
    RMSE_change_when_removed = RMSE - cv_summary$RMSE[cv_summary$model == "Full"],
    CV_R2_change_when_removed = CV_R2 - cv_summary$CV_R2[cv_summary$model == "Full"]) 
```

## Visualization

```{r}
res_all <- bind_rows(res_noun, res_verb, res_adj) %>%
  mutate(bias = factor(bias, levels = c("Noun", "Verb", "Adjective")),
         block = factor(block, levels = c("Typology", "Frequency", "Culture")),
         sig = case_when(p < .001 ~ "***", p < .01 ~ "**", p < .05 ~ "*", p < .10 ~ "+",
                         TRUE ~ ""),
         label = sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", partial_R2)))
res_all


bias_cols <- c("Noun bias" = "#2C7BB6", "Verb bias" = "#1A9850", "Adjective bias" = "#D95F02")

res_plot <- res_all %>%
  mutate(bias_type = dplyr::recode(bias,
                                   "Noun" = "Noun bias",
                                   "Verb" = "Verb bias",
                                   "Adjective" = "Adjective bias"),
    bias_type = factor(bias_type, levels = c("Adjective bias", "Verb bias", "Noun bias")),
    block = factor(block, levels = c("Typology", "Frequency", "Culture")),
    label = sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", partial_R2)))

ggplot(res_plot, aes(x = block, y = bias_type, size = partial_R2, fill = bias_type)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "gray80", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.4, color = "white") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = bias_cols) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 18, limits = c(0, .55)) +
  labs(x = "Predictor domain", y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = "none", size = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey87"),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray15",
                               lineheight = 0.92, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray15"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray15"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 2, 4))
ggsave(here("Figures", "preds_balance.png"), width = 4, height = 2.4, dpi = 320, bg = "white")
```
